evidence.detail: swiss command has num_players, num_rounds, top_n slash options — no num_byes parameter
swisscalc() uses a closed-form MTGSalvation formula that assumes all players start at 0-0; byes require splitting the player pool into two starting distributions (0-0 and 1-0) and merging them

triage.notes: The current algorithm is a single-distribution closed-form formula. Supporting byes requires running two separate distributions (bye and non-bye players) and merging at each round step, which is a non-trivial algorithmic extension well beyond 150 lines.
